column1: # Provenance of the corpus behind corpus-metadata.tsv: where each part came
# from and when. SPEC section 7 U-2: currency is its own check, never inferred
# from agreement. The test is crates/mlmf-test-support/tests/corpus_currency.rs.
# POLICY (S-35). A row is CURRENT for MAX_AGE_DAYS (180) after `fetched_utc`;
# after that the test FAILS until someone re-fetches the source, re-runs the
# census, and records the new date and revision here. Bumping the date
# without re-fetching defeats the check: this file records a fetch, not a wish.
# Offline by design (CI has no model files and no network), so it measures
# AGE, not "upstream moved". A moved upstream is found at the refresh.
# `basis`: `manifest` = date copied from the corpus's MANIFEST.json;
# `mtime` = no recorded fetch date, so the files' modification time (UTC) is
# used as the nearest available lower bound on it.
# `revision`: the upstream commit the files were fetched at, `-` = not recorded.
# Corpus tiers whose provenance is NOT recorded here (listed so a partial
# record is visible, not silent): gguf-corpus/tinyllamas (added 2026-09-25,
# absent from MANIFEST.json) and the safetensors checkouts behind
# corpus-safetensors.tsv (TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 has a git origin and revision but no fetch date).
